decision: Track LendingProtocol, SingleAssetVault and LendingProtocolV1_1 independently.
Do not treat the native loan-broker board as live until the required amendments activate and live objects appear.
Keep raRVLN's AMM classification separate from the unverified vault/loan-broker sections.
Do not infer collateralization from the 20M XRP transfer or unloaded explorer tables.
invariants: No merge, force-push, workflow dispatch, paper-state mutation or real-money trade.
No collateral inference without activated amendments and verified ledger objects.
